text_zh: 「以铅为誓，以键为途——汝之双手，即是引擎初见之门。」
text_en: "By lead sworn, by keys bound—thy hands shall be the Engine's first gate."

text_zh: 「废铅之中，圣字犹存——甄别者拾遗补缺，令破碎经卷重归完整。」
text_en: "In discarded lead, sacred letters endure—the Sifter gathers fragments to restore broken codices."

text_zh: 「蜡炬既燃，形可重塑——塑形者以火为师，令铭文在熔流中新生。」
text_en: "When wax burns, forms may be reborn—the Shaper learns from flame, birthing inscriptions anew."

text_zh:
ORDER-000 · 征用品
分类: 标准消耗

入会条件: 无。按§4.2自动指派。
编制状态: 临时人员，待分流。
装备授权: 基础铅字圣坛，标准祷击手册。
失联率: 基准值。无异常增益或减损。
备注: 大多数D级人员维持此状态直至任务完成。
无特殊神学倾向记录。
text_en:
ORDER-000 · Standard Issue
Classification: Basic Expendable

Entry Requirements: None. Auto-assigned per §4.2.
Status: Temporary personnel, awaiting assignment.
Equipment Clearance: Basic lectern, standard litany manual.
Loss Rate: Baseline. No anomalous gains or deficits.
Notes: Most D-class maintain this state until task completion.
No theological inclinations on record.

text_zh:
ORDER-117 · 铭刻誓门
分类: 正规编制

入会条件: 铅屑甄别测试合格，圣字钉造册能力认证。
神学立场: 形不可变。引擎之形须锁死于当前版型。
编制职能: 废铅分拣，收容经卷编纂。报告显示此类人员铭刻时'每个铅字都在正确位置'。
装备授权: 精密字盘，甄别放大镜。
备注: 持有者失联率显著下降。附带现象：工作区域异常整洁。
text_en:
ORDER-117 · Order of the Graven Oath
Classification: Regular Staff

Entry Requirements: Lead fragment sorting certification, glyph cataloging qualification.
Theological Position: Form immutable. Engine configuration must remain locked.
Duties: Scrap lead sorting, containment codex compilation. Personnel report 'every slug in its proper place' during inscription.
Equipment Clearance: Precision type case, sorting magnifier.
Notes: Significantly reduced loss rate. Associated phenomenon: work areas remain anomalously organized.

text_zh:
ORDER-241 · 熔变誓门
分类: ████编制

入会条件: 污蜡耐受测试，熔铸适应性评估。
神学立场: 顺应引擎之变。形态演进为必然过程。
编制职能: 铭文组重塑，熔铸盲盒处理。D-████报告铭刻时'铅字在流动，但这是对的'。
装备授权: 熔炉权杖，防腐蚀手套。
备注: 人员身体逐渐出现金属质感。原因不明。按§██.█无需干预。
text_en:
ORDER-241 · Order of the Molten Verse
Classification: ████ Staff

Entry Requirements: Corrupted ichor tolerance test, reforging adaptability assessment.
Theological Position: Embrace Engine transformation. Morphological evolution as inevitable process.
Duties: Inscription reforging, molten cache processing. D-████ reported 'the slugs flow, but this is right' during inscription.
Equipment Clearance: Crucible staff, corrosion-resistant gloves.
Notes: Personnel gradually develop metallic skin texture. Cause unknown. Per §██.█, no intervention required.
